{{Quote|You wouldn't happen to know a Cal Handro, would you?|Wolff Kalos, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WYG" />}}
'''Wolff Kalos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who operated on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have representatives from both sides of this war coming to me with offers and threats. I don't really want to deal with either one. |[[Tierce Martano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:WYG" />}}
Wolff Kalos had a sister named [[Mirrian]] who lived in their [[Wolff Kalos's family|parent's]] old home. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] Wolff Kalos was based on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. Serving under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garax Hadriin]], he was stationed in a [[Rebel Base (Garax Hadriin)|small base]] in the [[Asworal Everglades|jungle]]<ref name="SWG:FtE" /> but spent most of his time working from the city of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]].<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Wolff Kalos was involved in the hunt for [[Cal Handro]],<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> a missing pilot who had vanished after crash-landing on Rori. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the Rebel Alliance in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] when he crashed. He was thus wanted by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate and the by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:MtYBF">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "More than You Bargained For"</ref> Rebel Officer [[Veega Madish]] was originally tasked to rescue the pilot but the situation evolved when the Alliance discovered that Handro used to smuggle [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for Imperial-aligned [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers. Wolff Kalos was ordered to capture the pilot, now considered as a traitor.<ref name="SWG:Gc">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "Getting closer?"}}</ref> Cal Handro had taken shelter at the [[Martano estate|estate]] of an old friend, the wealthy gambler [[Tierce Martano]]. However, he was finally found by Black Sun henchmen who attacked the estate. Martano contacted both Wolff Kalos and Imperial Officer [[M'Kae/Legends|M'Kae]] to negotiate the location of the pilot in exchange for help against the Black Sun.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=Rebel Alliance}}
Before Tierce Martano could get an answer from Kalos or M'Kae, he was rescued by a group of spacers who eliminated all Black Sun forces. These spacers were recruited by Rebel Officer Madish to find the missing pilot.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> As Martano wished to get rid of Handro, he eagerly accepted to give the location of Handro to the spacers who contacted Wolff Kalos. The latter immediately sent agents to pick Cal Handro and transferred him to a [[Rebel Safe House]]. However, the Empire also got the information and promptly dispatched a group of mercenary to attack the building. Although the spacers arrived rapidly to help the Rebel forces, the pilot used the diversion to escape with a group of Imperial agents. Handro accepted the help of the Empire and eventually left Rori aboard a [[Warlord Heavy Cruiser]].<ref name="SWG:FtA">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Quest: "For the Alliance!"}}</ref>

While Cal Handro was about to leave the Naboo system, Wolff Kalos dispatched the Rebel spacers to interrogate Officer M'Kae, Tierce Martano's Imperial contact, because they suspected him to be involved in Handro's escape. Since the Imperial officer was not eager to reveal anything, Kalos ordered his agents to attack a small [[Imperial Base (Rori)|Imperial Base]] on Rori where M'Kae was stationed in order to collect incriminating evidence on the Imperial officer. After a successful assault, that also resulted in the death of Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Brant Korra|Korra]], M'Kae finally revealed that Cal Handro was about to leave the system to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The spacers rushed to the nearest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and launched in space to intercept [[Cal Handro's Warlord Heavy Cruiser|Cal Handro's ship]]. Piloting their own [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the spacers attacked the Imperial [[Light cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and its escort. Cal Handro eventually died in the explosion of the ship.<ref name="SWG:FtA" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:SWG_rebel_sergeant_major_Template.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Possible depiction of Wolff Kalos.]]
Wolff Kalos was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wolff Kalos was added to the game with the fourth chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>

Since Verks spawned under the generic "rebel_sergeant_major" template utilizing six different Interchange File Formats, his appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions and would fluctuate after each server reset. Nevertheless, the quest journal identified Verks as a male.<ref name="SWG:WYG" />

In the fourth chapter of "Secrets of the Syren", the player had to choose to side with either the Empire or the Rebels. The story diverged at this point since Cal Handro would always join the faction opposed to the player.<ref name="SWG:WYG" /> With the Empire, the player would be working for Officer M'Kae and would have to force Wolff Kalos to reveal the location of Cal Handro, through bribery or by threatening [[Wolff Kalos's family|Kalos's family]].<ref name="SWG:FtE" />
